name: Daily derived publication
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: public-snapshot
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  ingest:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: knowledge-publication
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: pip install .
      - name: Capture and validate a complete snapshot
        run: python -m gateway.cli run
        env:
          SOURCE_READ_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_READ_TOKEN }}
          INGEST_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.INGEST_DATABASE_URL }}
          EMBEDDING_REVISION: 1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41
          PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ vars.PUBLIC_API_URL }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: capture-evidence
          path: artifacts/
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: site/
  pages:
    needs: ingest
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        id: deploy

# WeBuild read-only knowledge gateway

Independent Python project. Source repositories are fetched through public HTTP GET,
read-only GraphQL queries, and Git fetch only. No source-write API, workflow, issue,
PR, comment, or source-side metadata operation exists in this project.

The generated GitHub Pages wiki provides browse/search/filter/download operations.
FastAPI REST and official MCP SDK Streamable HTTP serve the same `Store` methods.
PostgreSQL full-text search and pgvector cosine search use real revision-pinned
Sentence Transformers embeddings on CPU. Model weights are not mocked. No chatbot
or visitor editing, posting, submission, or collaboration feature is provided.

See [operator runbook](docs/RUNBOOK.md), [requirements/evidence mapping](docs/REQUIREMENTS.md),
and [validation report](docs/VALIDATION.md). Evidence is under `evidence/`.

## Local deployment

1. Copy `.env.example` to an untracked `.env`, replace passwords/origins/URLs.
2. Start the PostgreSQL service: `docker compose up -d db`.
3. Create `gateway_reader` and `gateway_ingest` login roles and apply
   `sql/schema.sql` with a database administrator. `scripts/bootstrap.py` is a
   convenience initializer using `ADMIN_DATABASE_URL` and `BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD`.
   Rotate to different reader/writer passwords afterward. Never give retrieval
   the administrator or ingestion URL.
4. `python -m venv .venv`; install the project: `.venv/bin/pip install '.[test]'`.
5. With ingestion credentials and `PUBLIC_API_URL` set:
   `python -m gateway.cli run --initial`. Full runs omit `--initial`.
6. Start retrieval: `uvicorn gateway.api:factory --factory --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000`.
   Its environment contains only `RETRIEVAL_DATABASE_URL`, model revision, host,
   and approved origins. Put Caddy or another HTTPS proxy in front of it.
7. Host `site/` on GitHub Pages; configure the new repository's Actions variables
   and protected environment as described in the runbook.

Anonymous GitHub reads work for small runs; the historical four-repository crawl
needs a read-only token to avoid the 60-request anonymous API quota. Partial or
failed captures are explicitly reported and never promoted by the production CLI.
Live file-only integration evidence is deliberately separate from a release run.

## Interfaces

- REST: `GET /v1/search`, `/v1/sources/{id}`, `/v1/relations`,
  `/v1/decisions/{id}/history`, `/v1/changes`, `/v1/manifest`.
- Remote MCP: `/mcp`; `search`, `get_source`, `get_related_sources`,
  `get_related_specs`, `get_decision_history`, `get_changes`.
- Exports: source JSONL, relationship JSON, Markdown topic pack, `llms.txt`.
- Health: `/health`, publication age >36 hours yields HTTP 503.

All retrieval responses identify their snapshot. Search has bounded query length,
page size and offset; REST and MCP share filters, model compatibility checks,
citations, statuses, versions, and restrictions on source content. Lifecycle state
never implies accepted status. Unknown status stays unknown. Link-only external
metadata never silently upgrades a cited baseline to the latest upstream version.

## Tests

Apply the schema to a disposable PostgreSQL/pgvector database, set the three DB
URLs and pinned `EMBEDDING_REVISION`, then run `python -m pytest -q`.
Tests use real embeddings and database queries; HTTP transport tests use an actual
listening service and official MCP client. Only pagination/error-path transport
fixtures use controlled responses. `scripts/live_validation.py` separately indexes
live public file evidence, measures source-derived and held-out formulations,
checks HTTP REST/MCP parity, and optionally runs a Playwright browser check.

## Publication status

This source is independently runnable. It has not been published to a GitHub owner
or deployed to production. Historical capture completeness and production HTTPS,
Pages coordination, notification routing, backups and performance are distinct
release checks; see the validation report. Private-source serving is intentionally
blocked until authenticated access control across every export/cache is implemented.

# Operator runbook

## Boundaries and credentials

Create a NEW repository named `webuild-knowledge-index` under an explicitly chosen
owner. Never copy project files into consortium source repositories or VDX-infra.
The ingestion adapter uses only public repositories selected in `config/sources.json`.
Organization discovery records new repositories but does not auto-admit them.
Review configuration in this project to admit additions.

- Retrieval container: reader DB URL, model revision, service host, approved website
  origins. No GitHub token, ingestion password, admin password, or model API key.
- Ingestion job: separate derived-data writer DB role and optionally a fine-grained
  GitHub token with repository contents/issues/pull requests/discussions READ ONLY.
  No source write permissions. Use a dedicated account/token, not a developer PAT.
- Database initializer: administrator privileges, used only for schema/roles.
- Pages publication: Actions Pages and OIDC permissions only in this NEW repository.

Configure the new repository's protected `knowledge-publication` environment:
`SOURCE_READ_TOKEN`, `INGEST_DATABASE_URL` secrets and `PUBLIC_API_URL` variable.
Configure GitHub Pages to deploy through Actions. The ingestion database connection
must be reachable from the selected runner and use TLS with certificate verification
when crossing a public network (`sslmode=verify-full` and a CA certificate).
The service domain must resolve to the separately hosted HTTPS reverse proxy.
Set exact `SERVICE_HOST` and `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (including the scheme).

## First ingestion and acceptance

Run `python -m gateway.cli capture --initial`. Inspect every coverage entry and
its source-type counts before publishing. The adapter fetches the complete default
branch tree, all-state historical issues and PRs, all comments, reviews, review
comments and releases, with all pagination followed. Truncated Git trees fail
closed. Discussions include independently paginated comments and replies when a
read-only GraphQL credential exists. Wiki reads use a temporary bare Git fetch;
attachments are link/metadata records, with binary extraction explicitly excluded.

`capture` writes project-owned per-repository checkpoints and a coverage manifest.
`publish` refuses failed/partial captures and writes records, sections, relationships
and publication pointer in one DB transaction. `generate` emits pages and exports
for the exact resulting snapshot. Daily `run` combines these steps. Full crawling
on EVERY run reconciles removed records and all contribution updates; it is more
expensive than incremental overlap polling but avoids cursor gaps. Weekly runs
therefore already perform full reconciliation. Incremental network/embedding cache
optimization is a later performance improvement, not a completeness shortcut.

Inspect whether GitHub Discussions are enabled but lack credentials; those gaps
must be resolved before claiming coverage. `not-present-or-unavailable` wiki results
need operator confirmation if wiki coverage matters. Source document status is
extracted conservatively; absent explicit status is unknown, even for merged files.
Confirm any reviewed annotation with an exact source revision and evidence spans.
Do not interpret a closed issue as an answered question.

## Recovery and withdrawal

Keep prior complete DB snapshots. Site search can choose latest live publication or
its pinned page snapshot; responses always expose the selected snapshot and date.
A failed ingestion is recorded in `ingestion_runs`; it leaves the last successful
publication pointer unchanged. `/health` exposes failures and publication age.
Re-run the same capture artifact safely; snapshots are content-addressed and
promotion is idempotent for identical records and coverage.

Successful full reconciliation revokes removed IDs across ALL historical retrieval
snapshots, then produces exports from the new public set. Never retain a source
after confirmed private/withdrawn status. Before production, verify the privacy
incident procedure: immediately revoke affected IDs using the INGEST role, rebuild
and redeploy sanitized Pages/exports, invalidate proxy caches, and rotate affected
credentials if needed. Public cached/downloaded copies cannot be recalled.
Automatic source privacy detection during an otherwise failed API capture is a
known remaining gap: keep release gated until the quarantine procedure is automated
and tested; rate-limit failures must not be mistaken for visibility changes.

To recover a publication pointer, use the ingestion role to set it to a verified
prior snapshot; first apply current revocations. Deploy the matching prior site
artifact. Don't delete the previous snapshot before Pages deployment succeeds.
The browser visibly reports service failures and permits static browsing.

## Freshness and monitoring

Run scheduled ingestion at 03:17 UTC. GitHub schedules are not an availability SLA.
Install `scripts/healthcheck.py` in an independent existing monitor, setting
`PUBLIC_API_URL`, and route its nonzero exit to an already authorized operational
channel. No notification is sent by this project and no contact/channel has been
selected. Monitor publication age, failed captures, API availability, TLS expiry,
DB storage, and embedding compatibility. Publication >36 hours old is failure.

## Production checks still requiring infrastructure

- Selected repository owner, hosting account, persistent DB and HTTPS domain.
- Distinct random reader/writer passwords, restricted network and DB TLS.
- Source read-only token and complete historical capture evidence.
- GitHub Pages publication and rollback exercised against the live backend.
- Independent monitor/authorized recipient channel configured and tested.
- Backups and restore drill; concurrent query/load and resource sizing measured.
- Automatic privacy quarantine and sanitized emergency publication.
- Binary/PDF extraction permissions and desired coverage explicitly approved.

Do not enable private sources until authorization protects source titles, links,
relations, derived annotations, counts, caches, downloads and exports separately
from the public publication boundary.

Authoritative scope: user-provided approved plan dated 7 October 2026. No VDX-infra
access was needed; the structured inventory/detail/overview/export/verification
pattern was implemented independently. Existing repositories were not modified.

| Requirement | Implementation | Evidence / limits |
|---|---|---|
| New write destination; source read-only | standalone root, GET-only `ingest.py`, query-only `discussions.py`, fetch-only `wiki.py` | Anonymous public corpus capture; no source mutation operations or existing local repositories |
| Stable IDs/revisions/permissions/provenance | `model.py`, records JSONB and immutable snapshots | SHA/revision URLs; file renames not yet reconciled to stable path aliases |
| Initial four repositories and broader configuration | `config/sources.json`, paginated adapters | Live default-branch file evidence for all 12; historical discussion crawl hit anonymous quota |
| Keyword and real vector search | `embeddings.py`, `store.py`, `sql/schema.sql` | Actual CPU neural embeddings, PostgreSQL 16 and pgvector queries; no mock embeddings |
| Section locators/context | deterministic section extraction, `chunks` table, matched locator | Section line ranges and document-level status remain connected |
| Exact status and lifecycle separation | deterministic status evidence and lifecycle fields | Accepted/proposed/draft/historical/unknown regression checks; merged does not imply accepted |
| Exact external versions | `model.py`, link-only `catalogue.py` | Exact cited version separate from nullable upstream version; official URLs and clause fragments |
| External catalogue and impacts | approved-host metadata, `catalogue.impacts` | Link-only; upstream official release comparison and clause-level catalogue remain limited |
| Evidence relationships | extracted `references`, `relations` and exports | Strong inferred relationships remain candidates via `annotations.py`; no consensus/compliance inference |
| GitHub Pages wiki/navigation/reading paths | `site.py`, daily Pages workflow | Working groups, topics, sources, reading paths, search filters, safe text rendering |
| Same REST/MCP implementation | `api.py` delegates all six tools/routes to `Store` | Actual official MCP HTTP client initialization, tool discovery/calls and parity |
| Read-only visitor access | no mutation routes/tools; DB reader role | Write denial tests, CORS and bounded queries; no chatbot/submissions/comments |
| Credential separation | SQL roles, distinct deployment environments | Actual reader-role write denial; container environment excludes source/ingest credentials |
| Coherent snapshots and recovery | transactional publication and pinned/latest search | Atomic failure, prior revision availability and model compatibility regression checks |
| Deletion/visibility boundary | tombstones across prior snapshots; quarantine and safe re-publication | Controlled tests across search/source/history/relationships; hosted withdrawal drill pending |
| Daily reconciliation | 03:17 UTC Actions, complete crawl every run, checkpoints | Full reconciliation daily also covers weekly requirement; incremental optimization pending |
| Partial failures/freshness | ingestion reports, failure-gated CLI, health >36 hours | Controlled stale capture and health tests; independent healthcheck script supplied |
| Safe parsing | archive streams never extracted/executed; escaped rendering; approved HTTP hosts | Source instructions remain data; PR test jobs receive no publication/source credentials |
| Portable exports | JSONL, relationship JSON, Markdown, `llms.txt` | Permission-filtered text; embedding metadata recorded separately |
| Source-derived evaluation/held-out questions | `scripts/live_validation.py`, controlled fixtures | No participant questions claimed; measured retrieval results and failures retained |
| Independently deployable HTTPS | Docker/Compose/Caddy example, SQL, workflows/runbook | No production host/account/owner selected; loopback HTTP transport validated |

historical issue/PR/comment/review ingestion with a read-only credential and inspect

production load remain explicit limitations rather than invented capabilities.
